title: Case 1: The Midnight Deploy
story: At 00:14 production broke. Three people were online. Only one of them deployed.
goal: Read the files in /case and name the user who deployed at 00:14.

files./case/auth.log:
00:02 login asha
00:09 login ravi
00:11 login meena
00:20 logout ravi

hints: Find who the deploy log blames: it only has a number.

Run:
cat /case/deploy.log
cat /case/users.txt
Then answer: meena
socratic: Which file is the oldest witness?
Do two files tell different stories?
Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
